name: ashell
summary: Ready-to-go Wayland status bar for Hyprland and Niri with workspaces, tray, media, network and power menus
description: ashell is a status bar that works out of the box on Hyprland, Niri and other Wayland compositors. It shows workspaces, the active window, system information, a tray, keyboard layout, clock with calendar and weather, media player controls, and a settings panel with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, VPN, audio, brightness, idle inhibitor and power actions. The TOML config hot-reloads, supports multiple monitors, and themes the bar as a solid strip or transparent islands.
